tei:div.tei:p: ༈ 479)e ma skal ldan rig pa 'dzin// mtshon byed dpe yi dbang bzhi bskur thabs dben// mtshon bya don gyi gsang dbang bskur ba'i thabs// spros med don dbang bskur thob bral ba'i dbang*// rigs ldan skyes bu khyod la bdag gis bstan/ e wam̐/ bdag lus ye nas rnam dag lha yi sku// rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje phag mor bzhengs// zung 'jug reg pa 'phrad pa sku yi dbang*// 'gyur med sku yi dbang rnams rdzogs thob nas// bskyed rim rnam dag rnam smin rig 'dzin thob// rang byung bde ba chen po'i rlabs shugs kyis// byang chub sems sprin bdud rtsi gsung gi dbang*// 'gags med gsung gi dbang rnams rdzogs thob nas// bzlas pa mthar phyin tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin// ye shes rtsa mchog ghan dhe'i cho 'phrul gyis// dpa' bos bde chen mthong ba shes rab dbang*// 'gyur med thugs kyi dbang rnams rdzogs thob nas// bde stong mngon gyur phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin brnyes// dga' bzhis nyer drangs stong bzhi'i ye shes mthong*// ye shes rnam thar gsum ldan tshig gi dbang*// spros 480)bral 'gyur med chen po'i dbang rdzogs thob// sku bzhi mngon gyur lhun grub rig 'dzin brnyes// de ltar bskur thob bral ba don gyi dbang*// kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo nga yis bskur// de don go bar mdzod cig rigs kyi bu/ sgyu ma'i bu mo zhal rdzun mkhan// sgyu ma'i snang ba 'khrul pa'i skabs// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin las// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang bzhi bskur// thabs grogs thugs bzhed skong phyir du// shes rab bde skyong dbang mos phul// snod min bu la gsang rgya mdzod/ dge'o// ༈ ka dag rig pa zang thal// bcos bsgyur 'dzin pas ma bcings// gsal stong 'dzin med ngang du// rig pa rang byung ye shes// blo 'das ye grol dgongs pa// ma bcos gnyug mar skyong mdzod// chos sku'i gtan srid zin yong*/

su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// ༈ rnal 'byor nyams kyis bslangs pa'i mtshar glu bzhugs so/ rang lo nyer dgu par rdo yul nyi ma lung gi dben gnas su bla ma'i drung du gnas skabs gzugs med lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul rtsal snang la shar nas rnam 'gyur ci rigs pa bstan tshe/ 481)bdag gis khyed rnams kyis bla ma lha la mos gus gyis lam ston bdag gis byed smras pas/ khyod rnal 'byor ma yin na 'dir 'dug pas ci byed/ dben pa'i gnas su 'gro ba bzang zer/ nga dben ri la yod smras pas/ na re/ khyod dben pa ci lta bu zhig la yod/ mos gus skyes na byin rlabs kyi sna kha ji 'dra yod/ bdag cag rnams la gsung du gsol zer ba snang tshe/ snang ba mtha' bral gyi dben ri la// 'khor 'das rgyan shar gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs// re dogs 'dzin bral gyi gnas lugs bskyangs// 'od gsal gnyug ma yi rang zhal mjal// snang ba rang grol gyi gdams pa yod// 'dzin med rang gsal gyi dben ri la// zhen bral 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs// ma bcos rang byung gi gnas lugs bskyangs// gtad med rgya yan gyi rang zhal mjal// nyon mongs rang grol gyi gdams pa yod// rtog bral rang byung gi rnal 'byor bzhugs// ma bcos rang byung gi gnas lugs bskyangs// gtad med rgya yan gyi rang zhal mjal// nyon mongs rang grol gyi gdams pa yod// rtog bral rang byung gi dben ri la// rkyen snang rang grol gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs// re dogs gnyis med kyi gnas lugs bskyangs// rang bzhin ngang grol gyi ye shes mjal// rang shar rang grol gyi gdams pa 482)yod// re dogs 'dzin bral gyi dben ri la// nyon mongs rang grol gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs// sku gsum ngang rdzogs kyi gnas lugs bskyangs// rtsol bral chos sku yi rang zhal mjal// 'khor 'das ye grol gyi gdams pa yod// spang thob bral ba yi gding bzhi thob// kun bzang bde chen dang dbyer med grol// rnal 'byor dben ri la bsnyegs tshul yin/

he he// ri la nyal ba dben ri min// ri dwags thams cad ri la nyal// srog gcod shan pa rtsar thon kyang*// skyabs dang re sa gcig kyang med// de don bsam na skyo ba skyes// bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// mos gus kyis gsol ba ma btab na// dgos 'dod kyi dngos grub mi 'byung bas// sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod// bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la// mos gus kyi dbang bzhi ma blangs na// dgongs brgyud kyi byin rlabs mi 'jug pas// sems mos gus= bla ma sku bzhugs kyi dkyil 'khor la// mos gus kyis zhabs tog ma bsgrub na// byin rlabs kyis rang rgyud mi grol bas// sems mos= bla ma'i gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas// gdams ngag gi bdud rtsi stsol ba'i dus// rtse gcig gi 483)mos gus ma skyes na// rang 'dra'i blo rgod de 'dul dka' bas// sems mos gus= bla ma'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// gsang mdzod zab mo'i chos sgo ba stsal// mos gus kyis rang rgyud ma bskul na// pha phog gi dngos grub 'byung mi srid// sems mos gus= bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan la// mos gus kyis mnyes gsum ma bsgrub na// bskyed bzlas rdzogs snying po rdul tsam med// sems mos gus= bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas dngos// mkhyen gnyis kyi ye shes thugs la mnga'// thugs rje la nye ring yod ma yin// mos gus kyis gsol ba ma btab na// 'dren stobs kyi thugs rjes 'dzin par dka'// sems mos gus= rang mthong gi nga rgyal skyur la thongs/ mos gus kyis bla mar gsol ba thob// chags sdang gi zhe sdang skyur la thongs// mos gus= 'gran sems kyi phrag dog skyur la thongs// mos gus= 'dod sems kyi chags zhen skyur la thongs/ mos gus= nyon mongs pa'i log lta skyur= /mos gus= nga'i bla ma kun bzang pad 'byung dngos// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchog /'dren mchog

484)bi ma rasmi la// dus kun 'bral med gsol ba btab// dgongs brgyud kyi byin rlabs sems la 'phos// gnyis 'dzin gyi mdud pa dbyings su grol// rlung sems la dbang 'byor ye shes mthong*// sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis med par// ye grol gyi chos sku'i klong du chub// rtsal sna chogs dbyings kyi rgyan du shar// gnyis 'dzin gyi re dogs rdzun phug zad// lha 'dre gnyis med sems kyi 'phrul du shar// sgyu ma'i 'phrul la rnal 'byor nga mi 'jigs// nga 'jigs med rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma// bdud bzhi tshar gcod kyi gdams pa yod// phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul la// re dogs yul med chen por gcod// nang bdag 'dzin zhen pa'i rtsa ba 'di// zhen med ye grol gyi klong du gcod// lus sems sdud pa'i kun gzhi 'di// shes rab gsum gyi ral gris bcad// gsang ba dug lnga'i rtog pa 'di// nyon mongs rang grol ngang du gcod// zhi byed zab mo'i dgongs klong du// 'khor 'das chos kun gnyis med gcod// nyon mongs 'khrul snang zhen pa'i rtsa ba 'di// chos dbyings ye shes lnga yi rang klong du/ 485)/rtsa bral dgongs pa klong chen gzhi ru grol// mnyam nyid chos sku'i dbyings su phaṭaḥkyis gcod// pha yis gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba gcod// pha rol phyin pa'i don kun khong du chud// ṭa ni 'khor 'das gnyis med gzhi las rdzogs// spang blang gnyis med kun bzang chos skur grol// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog ces smras pas khong rnams kyis phyag dang bskor ba byas zhing rang gnas su bzhud do/ zhes pa'ang su kha badz+ra gyis rtsal snang yi ge'i ris su bris pa'o// 486)
